Question: Which sentence uses present continuous with always to show irritation?

Choices:
A. [CORRECT] You are always leaving the door unlocked. It is so careless!
B. [WRONG] You always leave the door unlocked when you are in a rush.
C. [WRONG] You were always leaving the door unlocked when you lived alone.
D. [WRONG] You leave the door unlocked sometimes.

Verify these WRONG answers are incorrect: You always leave the door unlocked when you are in a rush., You were always leaving the door unlocked when you lived alone., You leave the door unlocked sometimes.
